body_markdown:
BW LPG’s Head of Procurement, Rick Ackermann, spoke at IMPA London 2026, held on 22-23 September at the Queen Elizabeth II Centre in Westminster. He delivered a keynote and joined two panel discussions on the future of maritime procurement.


In his keynote, **“The Advantages of Modern Buying and the Risk of Knowing Less,”** he reflected on how AI can help procurement teams take on more strategic work and become stronger partners to the business. But he also cautioned against “blind efficiency”: as technology takes on more tasks, professionals still need the knowledge and judgment to understand the decisions they make.


The discussions also looked beyond technology. A Leadership Debate explored how to retain knowledge and engage the next generation of procurement professionals, while a session with the Global Maritime Procurement Council (GMPC) covered collaboration, digitalisation, sustainability and industry leadership.


A highlight of the event was the chance to meet fellow supply chain professionals and exchange ideas in person- a reminder of the value of human connections in an increasingly digital profession.
